mapper.sql: SELECT t.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attachment_student a WHERE a.user_id = t.user_id AND a.student_id = t.id) AS attachment_count, o.name AS organization_name FROM student t LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.id = t.organization_id
mapper.select: ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student(user_id, title, student_name, organization_id, subject, stage, course_type, duration_minutes, fee, location, note, repeat_type) VALUES(#{userId}, #{title}, #{studentName}, #{organizationId}, #{subject}, #{stage}, #{courseType}, #{durationMinutes}, #{fee}, #{location}, #{note}, #{repeatType})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM student WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
